text: dsh-healthcheck 是一个 DSH 插件，通过 health_check 工具只读检查会话库和单个会话日志。无参数时汇总会话数、占用空间、事件数，并标出体积或事件数较大的会话；传入 session_id 时查看日志尾部轮次是否闭合、工具调用与结果配对及事件类型分布。适合排查长会话异常和崩溃残留，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-healthcheck provides a read-only DSH health_check tool. It summarizes session counts, storage, and events, flags large sessions, and inspects a selected log for an unclosed turn, unmatched tool calls, and event types. No keys or external services are needed.
想汇总 DSH 会话占用空间和事件数量。
帮我检查一个会话日志有没有异常结束或缺失工具结果。
I want to inspect session sizes and spot oversized DSH sessions.
dsh-healthcheck 的功能「会话库体检」：调用 health_check 且不传参数时，统计会话总数、总大小和事件数，列出体积最大的会话，并按阈值提示体积或事件数异常。

dsh-healthcheck README · dsh-healthcheck：**Runtime health check for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).** Read-only. Zero config.

A tiny plugin that helps you spot the two things that silently kill long dsh sessions: **runaway session size** (long-task OOM) and **crash-torn session logs**.

dsh-healthcheck README · What it does：- **`health_check`** (no arguments) — scans your whole session library:
  - totals: sessions / size / events
  - the largest sessions
  - warnings for oversized sessions (≥10 MB watch, ≥30 MB danger) and event-count blowups (≥3k watch, ≥8k danger) — the usual precursors of long-task OOM
- **`health_check session_id="<id>"`** — deep-inspects one session log:
  - tail balance (an unclosed turn means a crash tail; dsh auto-repairs it on resume — this just tells you it happened)
  - tool-call / result pairing
  - event-type distribution
dsh-healthcheck README · What it does：Everything is **read-only** — it never modifies a single byte of your data.
dsh-healthcheck README · Install：```sh

dsh-healthcheck README · requires pnpm on PATH (dsh plugin forwards to pnpm)：dsh plugin --profile web add github:neufagents/dsh-healthcheck
```

Then restart dsh and ask your agent:

> run a health check on my dsh sessions
section: requires pnpm on PATH (dsh plugin forwards to pnpm)

text:
dsh-healthcheck README · Compatibility：- Tested with dsh `0.1.5-rc.2` (developer preview). The rc line moves fast; issues welcome.
- Use **v0.1.1+**. v0.1.0 shipped raw TypeScript sources, which Node refuses to load from `node_modules` (`ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING`); v0.1.1 ships compiled JS in `dist/`.

dsh-healthcheck README · Development：```sh
npm i
npm run build     # tsc -> dist/ (compiled JS is what gets shipped)
npm test          # 11 tests (pure functions + contract)
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --patch ./dev.patch.yml --dump-config
